marks.gloss_en: 'no breach' -- that our company not be like David's company, from which Achitofel came out
כדרב יהודה אמר רב -- as the Bat Kol says: the whole world is sustained for Chanina's sake, and he himself on a kav of carobs a week
one said: the whole world is sustained by charity, and they [the stubborn-hearted, far from charity] are sustained by force
תדע, דהא לא איגייר גיורא מינייהו -- know it: no convert has ever come from them
Rav Yehuda: who are the stubborn-hearted? the foolish Gova'ei
דקא חזו יקרא דאורייתא תרי זמני בשתא ולא קמגייר גיורא מינייהו
Rav Ashi: the people of the town of Mechasya are the stubborn-hearted
every day a Bat Kol goes out from Mount Chorev and says: the whole world is sustained for the sake of Chanina My son, and for Chanina My son a kav of carobs suffices from Shabbat eve to Shabbat eve
a groom who wishes to recite the Shema on the first night may recite
RSbG is (as a rule) concerned for presumption
the attributions in one of the two sources are reversed
Shema depends on intent, and we are witnesses that the groom cannot direct his mind
one whose dead lies before him is exempt from reciting the Shema
construal: lying before him -- exempt; not lying before him -- obligated
the onen eats in another house, or in his fellow's house, or behind a partition, or turning his face; he does not recline, eats no meat, drinks no wine, does not bless, does not join zimmun
